blend: NORMAL (premultiplied alpha; PNG RGB is the flat colour, all shape is in alpha)
parallax_note: stage wall = 1.0; haze is in the air between wall and camera so >= 1.0
intensity_note: peaks are ~55% of the density of Michael's PSD example; multiply alpha by up to 1.6 to match his example exactly

layers.runtime: tileSprite.tilePositionX = cam.scrollX*parallax - t*wind_speed*gust(t); alpha = base*(1 - amount/2 + amount/2*sin(2*pi*t/period + phase))
tileSprite.tilePositionX = cam.scrollX*parallax - t*wind_speed*gust(t); alpha = base*(1 - amount/2 + amount/2*sin(2*pi*t/period + phase))

layers.draw_order: behind fighters (optionally a 2nd copy at alpha*0.5 in front)
layers.runtime: tileSprite.tilePositionX = cam.scrollX*parallax - t*wind_speed*gust(t); alpha = base*(1 - amount/2 + amount/2*sin(2*pi*t/period + phase))

gust_tile_scale_x.note: near haze tileScaleX lerps to 1.35 with the gust envelope (streaks visibly stretch); far/mid stay 1.0. Only the haze tile is scaled (soft alpha, no hard pixels to break).

gust.note: shared by wind layers, streaks and bags

v2_change: Michael: the wind did not read as moving (constant widths). v2 adds baked gust streaks that stretch, thin, swell and fade while travelling L->R, faster haze scroll, a haze tileScale/alpha pulse on gusts, and more frequent gusts.

streaks.layout: vertical strip: frame i at y=i*32 (logical); RGB flat (178, 153, 130), shape in alpha (peak 0.55)
streaks.anim: frame = floor(age*24*rate); the frames themselves do the stretch (35%->120% length), thinning with one swell pulse, and fade in/out; despawn after frame 23
streaks.runtime: x += speed*gust(t)*dt (screen space, spawn at x=-200 or anywhere along the band); alpha = class.alpha*(1+(gust-1)*0.3); random hflip OFF (head must lead to the right); random vflip ok
streaks.cost: <=24 sprites (~5 alive per class calm, ~12 in a gust), 6 sheets of 384x768 logical RGBA (~7 MB GPU total)
